Saddly disappointed.
Apr 2026 • Solo
Considering recommendations, I was disssapointedd. Quality was not bad . But: the carrot potatoes soup in a broth was so, so salty, that the vegies tastes like cubes of salt.I could not eat it. I asked for shrimp with tamarind sauce. I have been in Asia for a long time. I have had all kinds of tamarind sauce : ALWAYS sweet and sour. I asked if they gave me chilli sauce by mistake. They offered to change it for a sauce that came in a commercial bag! Considering the reputation of "home cooked" , I was aghast and declined it. The flavor of the shrimp and rice was not bad, but the hot chilli overpowered any tamarind it might have had. The combo also came with a small salad: lettuce, cherry tomato halves and some Thai basil. Very pleasant.
I asked for an iced coconut coffee: got a glass of room temperature coconut milk with a steaming hot expresso on the side. I asked for ice. ( In Virtnamese). I got an empty glass. I repeated myself. Someone told him again in Vietnamese. Finally he came back with ice. Actually, the coconut iced coffee I made with the provided ingredients, was very good, after I added some sweetener. ( Coffee must have been robusta.) They had several desserts on the menu. Their coasters read: cuisine, cafe, dessert. When I asked: all they had was Tiramisu. It did not look like Tiramisu. But zi decided to try it. It was quite good . Once cut, it looked like Tiramisu. Instead of the usual soaked savoiardi cookies, they used two layers of (moka)? cake or chocolate cake drizzled with coffee. On a scale of 1-5, I give it 4. I would come in for an afternoon Caffè Da and Tiramisu

Safe gluten free meal that was really tasty
Apr 2025 • Couples
I came here because this restaurant showed up on my gluten free search of Dalat and it was near our hotel. What a really nice atmosphere over several busy floors of happy customers. I explained my gluten free needs to the waiter and he took a photo of my translation card and then came back after talking with the kitchen staff, and he recommended the beef and veggie stir fry set, that comes with soup (yummy broth), salad with vinegrette and rice. I was really pleased at the size, presentation, and most of all the taste was really nice! I was full but not stuffed and everything felt light and fresh. It was also pretty cheap, so on a travel budget, it was great! I have to give a shoutout to the amazing wait staff who ran those stairs like athletes, making sure everyone was happy and getting their food quickly! We will be back! {Also I did not react to my meal at all! :) }
